notes.title: Slime King Update Part 1 Of 2
notes.content:
[u][b]Update Notes[/b][/u]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]


[list]
[*]Fixed some controller based bugs.
[*]Corrected some UI issues.
[*]Fixed some other minor bugs.
[/list]

[b]Changes And Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Controller UI and Camera function will auto enable when selecting from menu, pressing action button in game, or using the left and right sticks to move/look.
[*]Using WASD will set to Keyboard and Mouse mode.
[*]Increased Dragon Essence Production to accommodate eggs and purification more efficiently.  Earth and Arcane Essence from Dragons now produce daily.  All other essences produce every 3 days.
[*]Arcane Crystals now drop from all crystal nodes.
[*]Slimy's Past quest can now be completed.  It will now add the Slime King quest line.
[*]Completing the Slime King quest line will allow you to unlock Slime Creation.  New slimes can be created using other monsters.  Slimy will tell players what she needs once they interact with her.
[*]Can now turn off Bunyin Egg indicator from corral (select any Bunyin and the option will be under visibility).
[*]Slime Creation egg indicator can also be turned off at the Slime Creation interface.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed some controller based bugs.
- Corrected some UI issues.
- Fixed some other minor bugs.

tags.feature: - Controller UI and Camera function will auto enable when selecting from menu, pressing action button in game, or using the left and right sticks to move/look.
- Using WASD will set to Keyboard and Mouse mode.

tags.balance_change: - Increased Dragon Essence Production to accommodate eggs and purification more efficiently.  Earth and Arcane Essence from Dragons now produce daily.  All other essences produce every 3 days.

tags.feature: - Arcane Crystals now drop from all crystal nodes.

tags.bug: - Slimy's Past quest can now be completed.  It will now add the Slime King quest line.

tags.feature: - Completing the Slime King quest line will allow you to unlock Slime Creation.  New slimes can be created using other monsters.  Slimy will tell players what she needs once they interact with her.
- Can now turn off Bunyin Egg indicator from corral (select any Bunyin and the option will be under visibility).
- Slime Creation egg indicator can also be turned off at the Slime Creation interface.

notes.title: Patch Notes: V1.01
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]


[list]
[*]Fixed bug where if mounted or using dragon the day wouldn't transition correctly.
[*]Event locations now stay marked on the map as ? until completed.
[/list]

[b]Changes And Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Bunyin are now in the game.  The bunnies in the Meadows habitat will breed and produce egg every 2 days.  Eggs will grant first Bunyin then a random chance to get another one until you collect them all.  The chance starts at 15% and each time you don't get it a 5 to 10% bonus is added to increase your chances next time.  Egg must be hatched to produce another one.  Both bunnies and Bunyin start off at the baby stage and will grow to full size in 5 days if fed daily.
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed bug where if mounted or using dragon the day wouldn't transition correctly.
Event locations now stay marked on the map as ? until completed.

tags.feature: Bunyin are now in the game. The bunnies in the Meadows habitat will breed and produce egg every 2 days. Eggs will grant first Bunyin then a random chance to get another one until you collect them all. The chance starts at 15% and each time you don't get it a 5 to 10% bonus is added to increase your chances next time. Egg must be hatched to produce another one. Both bunnies and Bunyin start off at the baby stage and will grow to full size in 5 days if fed daily.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.007
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]


[list]
[*]The do not tame setting now resets if that monster type is no longer on your list of tamed monsters allowing you to tame it again.
[*]Villagers now correctly level up once XP reaches 100.  They were gaining XP without leveling up.  Villagers with more than 100 XP will automatically level up on game load.
[*]Cannot release villagers that have already been recruited to village if they show up in corral manager in error.
[*]Fusion correctly updates the compass.
[*]Arcane Crystal now works correctly from the Mine item selection.
[*]Fusion no longer causes character to be stuck if another monster enters and changes focus.  Players can use the stay command to ensure no other companion moves into player range when using mount or fuse.
[/list]

[b]Changes And Additions[/b]
[list]
[*]Gobi's market now chains upgrades and quests when you build rather than by reputation.
[*]Added villager unassign for house and work.
[*]Villagers no longer show up under corral manager.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.889.2
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where if using keyboard and mouse the food will be placed on ground even if no food was there (this didn't seem to affect taming since the value of food was 0).
[*]Fixed a bug where food would still be on ground even if depleted.
[*]Fixed Melina to now give quest on first contact.  Was stuck in the progression of quest even if quest wasn't obtained.  It now works as it should.
[*]Changed some controller UI functions.
[*]Fixed issue that rarely occurs when 2 monsters get to the food at the same time.  If food is finished the second monster will move on.
[*]Added close button to the sleep screen.  If it becomes unresponsive, you can now close it.  Some players have experienced it getting stuck once every few in game days.
[/list]

[b]New Content:[/b]

[list]
[*]Melina now sells monsters from Ironcliff once enough reputation is earned. 
[*]6 Ironcliff monsters added.
[*]Corral now has option to release monsters.
[/list]

notes.content:

[list]
[*]Melina's Ranch will allow for monsters to be returned at a cost of 10 Gold per day spent on Ranch.  Players will be able to retrieve monsters even if they don't have enough gold at the time.  They can cover the gold cost when the next monster is placed in ranch.
[*]Fixed Map Icon resizing for Melina and Sibling Characters.
[*]Added a close button to the Day Log in case it get's stuck.  It will appear within 5 seconds if there is an error.
[*]Fixed some pathing issues with Melina.
[*]Some other minor bugs were fixed.
[/list]

[b]Roadmap Progress: Patch: Patch: 0.889.2[/b]

[list]
[*]Melina will grant recipies for Scent Enhancer, Cake, and Milkshake on the next patch.  Currently not implemented but players will get them added if they have completed all quests from Melina.
[*]Melina's Ranch will sell monsters from Ironcliff if reputation is high enough.
[*]Melina's Ranch will provide a list of monsters needed in Ironcliff.  These monsters can be sold at x2 of their value.  Irconcliff reputation has to be high enough for this option to be open.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.889
notes.content:
New Content:

[list]
[*]Sibling of chosen character will reside on farm.
[*]Sibling can help with gathering, logging, mining and farming on the island.
[*]Sibling can assist with combat as an additional party member.

[/list]

Fixed a few bugs that resulted from new additions.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.885.5
notes.content:
-Despawn of an enemy now resets all it's agro stats.
-Added animation for death in air to the dragons.
-Fireballs now travel to target enemies even if flying.
-Increased Spawn Area to cover more height so monsters don't despawn when flying.
-Ranged enemies can detect flying dragons and can hit them with projectile based abilities.
-Entering area no longer sets target.  Caused a target to be set even if not in visible range of player.
-Breath Cool Down now fixed.
-Targeting now checks the distance to the enemy.  If enemy is not within attack range they will no longer be targeted.
-Using breath attack now drains increasing stamina when used, tiring out dragon faster the longer it is held.
-Fixed a bug with the farm house being invisible.
-Added rider animations when dragon runs and jumps to make it look more natural.
-Removed loading screen for switching/mounting/dismounting.  Will be adding some transition animations for mounting/dismounting at future update.
-Fixed some UI placements.
-Fixed UI reporting essence gained from gathering tasks twice.

-Fixed some UI placements.
-Fixed UI reporting essence gained from gathering tasks twice.

-Removed loading screen for switching/mounting/dismounting. Will be adding some transition animations for mounting/dismounting at future update.

notes.title: Quick Patch 0.871b
notes.content:
Quick Patch: Fixed movement in multiplayer mode for companions and enemies.
Updated Splash Screen

General Changes:


- Added graphics settings (default setting is lowest setting) to improve FPS if system requirements are lower than recommended.

General Changes:
Removed Vertical movement of camera to prevent jittery movements when using the mouse. Vertical angle is fixed now, as it doesn't affect anything at this time.

Single Player Changes and Fixes:

- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused character to not move after fusing and switching.
- Fixed audio for sweeping breath. Dragon now roars when using sweeping breath.
- Fixed cooldown for sweeping breath.
- Time no longer passes when in menu, inventory, crafting and conversations.
- Fixed bug where Friendly Fire deals damage to allies.
- Fixed bug where companions drop loot when defeated.
- Adjusted feed selection to prevent overfeeding.
- Fixed some UI elements.
- Changed reputation rewards for Gobi's tasks. They now give greater reputation points to the Goblins.
- Fixed UI issues with Gobi's Shop
- Fixed seeds on Gobi's Shop
- Fixed Human Villager bug.
- Fixed Homeworld Village Building Points to activate properly when starting a new game.
- Fixed Homeworld Village planter crops to correctly show growth phases in the planters.
- Fixed Villager and Tamed Monster skills that was broken on last patch. Players should see the skills now as they should be.
- Can now access storage from any crate in the Homeworld Village.
- Fixed storage boxes to add correct storage slots after Village storage boxes have been added during same game session.
- Fixed field blessings from blocking player when active.
- Fixed camera collisions to not collide with monsters.
- Companions now teleport to the shrine when selected to party.
- Village NPC now wander around where they are working to make it easier to find them and speak to them. Future Update: They will return home once work hours are implemented.
- Fixed some localization UI that were missed.
- Fixed some hidden bags so that they are now lootable.
- Mimic now add storage upon taming based on their type (+5, +10, +20).
- Mimic now provide bonus storage every 10 levels based on their type (+2, +4, +6).


New Mechanic:

- Dragon Horde - Dragons will each have a horde (currently only in Multiplayer). Horde will increase player and dragon level once it acquires enough gold. The Horde will have additional functionality in subsequent updates.

New Game Features And Modes:

- Added Local Multiplayer Mode to allow for 4 player split-screen.
- Multiplayer mode is a mini-game focused on combat with improved enemy and combat mechanics. Further updates will bring Multiplayer in sync with Single Player mode with improvements.

notes.title: Village Update 1
notes.content:
[b]New Mechanics and Content[/b]

Job Board is now active.
Build the Job Board near bridge to access it.
Gobi, Chief Gobi, and Melina will provide tasks for Reputation Points.

notes.title: Controller Support And More
notes.content:
Recap of some the updates made since late October 2022 Release.

Changed graphics of the game for much better visuals and performance.

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
Farming
Can now ride dragons for fast travel across the world.
Added a sister world which will have more combat oriented quests and more difficult enemies.
Improved taming system.
Added full controller support.

Many bug fixes reported by the community.
Some suggestions from the community implemented.

Thanks to all that have supported us in 2022 and we hope the game evolves to your liking in 2023!  Will be updating our Youtube Channel with tutorial videos and game guide like content.  Steam Community page there for you to let us know what you think we can improve on and any bugs you encounter!

Changed biome diversity for more enjoyable experience.
